title: Code, data and cached results for In Silico Modeling of Shear Stress and Energy Dissipation Rate Effects on Human Pluripotent Stem Cell Proliferation in Vertical-Wheel Bioreactors
description: Research code, curated measurements and CFD exposure summaries, saved model fits, final likelihood profiles, predictions, and figure/table reproduction scripts supporting the accepted Stem Cells Translational Medicine article SCTM-26-0107.R2. Code is Apache-2.0; data, cached results and figures are CC-BY-4.0. The archive does not contain raw CFD simulation projects or all historical optimization checkpoints. See README.md and LICENSES.md.
